info.title: Codevibe Sign HTTP API
info.summary: Send documents for signature, sign them, seal the PDF and verify it.
info.description:
The HTTP API of `@codevibe_technology/sign-server`. It has two audiences:

- **Senders** (your backend) create envelopes, send them and download the sealed PDFs.
  Every sender route needs `Authorization: Bearer <api key>`.
- **Signers** (the recipient's browser) open their signing link, verify a one-time code
  when the recipient needs one, and sign, approve or decline. Signer routes are
  authorised by the signing token in the path.

### Errors

Every error has the same JSON body, `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }`,
and each code always comes with the same HTTP status:

| Status | Codes |
| ------ | ----- |
| 400 | `VALIDATION` |
| 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED`, `TOKEN_INVALID`, `OTP_INVALID`, `OTP_EXPIRED` |
| 403 | `FIELD_NOT_YOURS`, `FORBIDDEN` |
| 404 | `ENVELOPE_NOT_FOUND`, `RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND`, `NOT_FOUND` |
| 409 | `INVALID_STATE`, `NOT_YOUR_TURN`, `CONFLICT` |
| 410 | `ENVELOPE_EXPIRED` |
| 413 | `DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE` |
| 422 | `REQUIRED_FIELDS_MISSING`, `INVALID_FIELD_VALUE`, `DOCUMENT_INVALID` |
| 423 | `OTP_LOCKED` |
| 429 | `RATE_LIMITED` |
| 500 | `SEAL_FAILED`, `INTERNAL` |
| 502 | `PROVIDER_ERROR`, `WEBHOOK_INVALID` |

Validation errors list each problem in `details.issues` as `{ path, message }`, for
example `recipients[1].email`. Stack traces never leave the server.

### Workspaces

Every envelope belongs to the workspace of the credential that created it. A sender only
sees and acts on its own workspace's envelopes; an id from another workspace answers
`ENVELOPE_NOT_FOUND`, exactly like one that does not exist. A read-only credential (for
example a viewer's) may only call `GET` routes and gets `FORBIDDEN` otherwise.

### Retries

POST routes accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. A retry with the same key and the same
body within 24 hours gets the first response back, marked `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.
Server errors (5xx) are not stored, so they can be retried with the same key.

### Rate limits

Limits are per API key (creating envelopes), per signing token and per client IP
(signer routes), and per recipient (one-time codes). A request over a limit gets `429`
with `RATE_LIMITED` and a `Retry-After` header in seconds.

baseUrl.description: Where the server listens, without a trailing slash.

tags.name: Envelopes
tags.description: Create, change, send and withdraw envelopes. Sender API key required.

tags.name: Audit and files
tags.description: The audit log, the certificate, and the original and sealed PDFs.

tags.name: Signing
tags.description:
What the recipient's browser calls. `{token}` is the signing token from the link,
or the literal `link` to use the token held in the `cvsign_link` cookie.

get.description: Answers as long as the process serves requests. It does not touch the store.

The OpenAPI 3.1 description of this server's API. Public and cacheable: send the
`ETag` back as `If-None-Match` to get `304 Not Modified` while it is unchanged.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: The `ETag` of a copy you already have.

get.description:
The caller's workspace's envelopes, newest first, one page at a time. Pass the
`nextCursor` of a page as `cursor` to get the next one. Each row is a summary without
fields or values; get the envelope for those.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive text anywhere in the title.

post.description:
Creates a draft with its documents, recipients and fields, and sends it at once when
`send` is `true`. Send the PDFs either as base64 in JSON, or as a multipart upload with
the envelope JSON in a form field named `envelope` and the files as `documents`.

The example carries a real one-page PDF, so it works as it is in Test Request.

Each PDF is checked: at most 20 MB by default, at most 20 per envelope, and it must
open as a PDF. Field boxes are in PDF points from the top-left corner of the page and
must fit on it.

sendNow.summary: Send an offer letter to two signers

201.description: The envelope, as a draft or already sent.

get.description: The envelope with its documents, recipients, fields and the values entered so far.

patch.description:
Changes a draft envelope. Only the properties you send change. `recipients` and
`fields`, when sent, replace the whole list: pass a recipient's `id` to keep it (its
signing order and details are updated), leave it out to remove it. Fields name their
recipient by `key` or `id` and their document by `id` or position (`"0"`).
Documents cannot be changed; create a new envelope instead. Send `"message": null`
to remove the message.

post.description:
Sends the draft. In sequential routing the recipients with the lowest `order` get their
signing links; in parallel routing everyone does. Viewers get a copy once it is complete.
The envelope needs at least one signer or approver, and every signer needs a signature
field.

Withdraws a sent envelope that is not yet final. Signing links stop working and
recipients already invited are told it was withdrawn.

reason.description: Shown to recipients and kept in the audit log.

example.reason: The offer was sent to the wrong address.

post.description:
Mails a reminder with a fresh signing link to everyone whose turn it is, or to the one
recipient named. Each recipient gets at most one reminder or invitation every 15
minutes; manual reminders do not count against the automatic ones.

200.description: The envelope, with `lastRemindedAt` set on everyone reminded.

get.description:
Every action on the envelope, oldest first, and whether the hash chain is intact: each
event's `hash` is `sha256(prevHash + canonical(event))` and the last one must equal the
envelope's `auditHead`.

200.description: The events and the chain check.

get.description:
The sealed PDF once the envelope is complete, otherwise the original. Ask for one of
them with `version`.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: `original`, or `sealed` (fails with `INVALID_STATE` until sealing has finished).

get.description:
Runs the seal check on the stored sealed file against the operator certificate and any
older certificates the server trusts.

What the certificate page of the sealed PDF shows, as JSON: the hash of each document
before and after sealing, each recipient with the authentication they used and every
action they took, and the head of the audit chain.

For a recipient who has signed or approved. The submit call hands back a receipt, as
the `cvsign_receipt` cookie and the `X-Sign-Receipt` header, valid for 7 days. With it
the recipient can see where the envelope stands, how many people it is still waiting
for (not who), and which documents are sealed and ready to download. The signing link
itself stops working once the recipient has acted.

The sealed PDF, once everyone has acted and the seal is applied. Before that the
answer is `INVALID_STATE`; poll `GET /v1/sign/receipt` until the document's `sealed`
is `true`.

The envelope basics, the recipient, their own fields and values, and what they still
need to do. For recipients who sign with a one-time code, `otpRequired` is `true` and
`authenticated` says whether a valid session came with the request. `canAct` is
`false` while it is someone else's turn.
The document to sign. Recipients who sign with a one-time code must verify it first.

post.description:
Sends a new six-digit code by email or SMS, valid for 10 minutes, and replaces the
previous one. At most 5 codes per 15 minutes and 10 per recipient over the envelope's
life; after that the answer is `OTP_LOCKED` with `details.reason: "too_many_codes"`
and the sender has to send the envelope again.

200.description: The code is on its way.

sentTo.description: The masked address or number the code went to.

post.description:
Checks the code. On success the server sets a 30-minute `cvsign_session` cookie
(HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, path `/v1/sign`) and also returns the session, which you
can send as `X-Sign-Session` instead. Five wrong guesses lock the code (`OTP_LOCKED`);
ask for a new one.

sessionToken.description: Send it as `X-Sign-Session` on later requests.

post.summary: Record that the document was opened
post.description:
Marks the recipient as having viewed the document. Call it when the page shows the
document, not when the link is opened, so mail scanners that follow links change
nothing.

Submits the recipient's field values and their consent to sign electronically. Signers
must fill every required field; approvers send an empty `values` list. When the last
required recipient acts, the envelope completes and the sealed PDF is produced.

consent.description: The signer agrees to sign electronically.

200.description:
Where the envelope and this recipient stand now, with a receipt for following the
envelope and downloading the signed copy (`GET /v1/sign/receipt`).

X-Sign-Receipt.description: The receipt. Send it back as `X-Sign-Receipt`.

post.description: Declines to sign. The envelope becomes `declined` and everyone already invited is told.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The signing token from the email.

get.description:
Where signing links point. Stores the token in an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict
`cvsign_link` cookie (path `/v1/sign`, at most 24 hours) and redirects to the signing
page, whose URL carries no token. The page then calls `/v1/sign/link/...` from the same
origin. An unknown or used token clears the cookie and redirects all the same, adding
`?state=` with the reason (`signed`, `completed`, `declined`, `voided`, `expired` or
`invalid`) and, when the envelope is known, `&w=<workspaceId>` so the page can explain
it in the sender's brand. This route only reads: opening a link does not mark the
document as viewed.

Location.description: The signing page, without the token; for a dead link with `?state=`.

post.description:
Sent to each configured webhook URL for the audit actions it subscribes to (`*` for
all), one delivery per action. The body is fixed when the event happens, so a retry
delivers the same bytes with the same `id`. Failed deliveries (no 2xx within 10 s) are
retried with backoff, from 30 seconds up to 12 hours, nine attempts in all.

Verify each delivery before trusting it: the `x-codevibe-signature` header is
`t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>">` with the target's secret.
Reject it when the HMAC does not match or `t` is more than five minutes old.
`verifyWebhook(secret, header, rawBody)` from the server or client package does this.

parameters.name: x-codevibe-delivery
parameters.description: The delivery id, the same as `id` in the body. Use it to drop duplicates.

2XX.description: Received. Answer quickly; any other status, or no answer in 10 s, is retried.

post.description:
Sent when someone asks for a test delivery, for example with "Send test event" in the
app, to check that the receiver is reachable and verifies signatures. It is signed and
carries the same headers as an envelope event, but has no envelope and is never
retried. Answer it like any other delivery.

parameters.name: x-codevibe-delivery
parameters.description: The delivery id, the same as `id` in the body.

data.message: This is a test event from Codevibe Sign. Answer with any 2xx status.

apiKey.description:
A sender API key from the server's `apiKeys` option, as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
Keys are at least 16 characters.

signerSession.name: X-Sign-Session
signerSession.description:
The `sessionToken` from `POST /v1/sign/{token}/otp/verify`, for recipients who sign
with a one-time code. Valid for 30 minutes and only with the token it was issued for.

signerSessionCookie.name: cvsign_session
signerSessionCookie.description: The same session as an HttpOnly cookie, set by `otp/verify` for browsers.

linkCookie.name: cvsign_link
linkCookie.description:
Holds the signing token after `GET /sign/{token}`. Used when the path has `link` in
place of the token. Requests other than GET must come from the same site.

signerReceipt.name: X-Sign-Receipt
signerReceipt.description:
The receipt from a successful `POST /v1/sign/{token}/submit`. Valid for 7 days, for
that recipient and envelope only.

signerReceiptCookie.name: cvsign_receipt
signerReceiptCookie.description: The same receipt as an HttpOnly cookie, set by `submit` for browsers.

SigningToken.name: token
SigningToken.description:
The signing token from the link (43 base64url characters), or `link` to use the
token in the `cvsign_link` cookie. Anything else is refused with `TOKEN_INVALID`.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
Any unique string, up to 255 characters. A retry with the same key and body within
24 hours returns the first response. The same key with a different body is a
`VALIDATION` error; while the first request is still running, `CONFLICT`.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when this is the stored response to an earlier request with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

SignerStatus.description: Where the envelope and this recipient stand now.

BadRequest.description: `VALIDATION`: the request is malformed. `details.issues` lists each problem.

error.message: recipients[0].email is not a valid email address

issues.message: recipients[0].email is not a valid email address

Unauthorized.description: `UNAUTHORIZED`: the API key is missing or not valid.

error.message: Send an API key as Authorization: Bearer <key>

SignerUnauthorized.description:
`TOKEN_INVALID`: the link is unknown, used, expired or withdrawn.
`OTP_INVALID`: the code is wrong (`details.attemptsLeft`), or the session is missing
(`details.otpRequired`). `OTP_EXPIRED`: the code timed out or none was sent.

error.message: This signing link is no longer valid

Forbidden.description: `FIELD_NOT_YOURS`: a value names a field that belongs to another recipient.

error.message: This credential can only read envelopes

Conflict.description:
`INVALID_STATE`: not allowed in the envelope's status (`details.status`).
`NOT_YOUR_TURN`: sequential routing, an earlier recipient has not acted.
`CONFLICT`: another request changed the envelope, or one with the same
`Idempotency-Key` is still running; try again.

error.message: Only draft envelopes can be changed

Gone.description: `ENVELOPE_EXPIRED`: the envelope is past its expiry.

TooLarge.description: `DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE`: a PDF or the whole request is over the limit (`details.maxBytes`).

Unprocessable.description:
`DOCUMENT_INVALID`: a file is not a readable PDF.
`REQUIRED_FIELDS_MISSING`: required fields were left empty.
`INVALID_FIELD_VALUE`: a value does not suit its field (PNG, date, length).

Locked.description: `OTP_LOCKED`: too many wrong guesses, or too many codes for this envelope (`details.reason`).

error.message: Too many requests, try again later

ServerError.description: `INTERNAL` or `SEAL_FAILED`. Safe to retry with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

ErrorCode.description: A stable error code. `x-status` maps each code to the HTTP status it always comes with.

message.description: A sentence for people. Do not parse it; use `code` and `details`.

details.description:
More about the error, depending on the code: `issues` (`VALIDATION`),
`retryAfterSeconds` (`RATE_LIMITED`), `attemptsLeft` (`OTP_*`), `status`
(`INVALID_STATE`), `maxBytes` and `document` (document errors).

RecipientRole.description: Signers fill fields, approvers approve without fields, viewers get a copy.

AuthMethod.description: How the recipient proves who they are. `email_link` needs only the link.

Routing.description: `sequential` goes by `order`, lowest first (equal orders sign together); `parallel` invites everyone at once.

Rect.description: A box in PDF points, measured from the top-left corner of the page.

firstAfterDays.description: Days after the invitation for the first reminder; 0 turns reminders off.

Metadata.description: Your own data, for example an employee id. Echoed in webhooks.

fileKey.description: Where the server's file store keeps the original.

pageSizes.description: Size of each page in PDF points, in page order.

readOnly.description: Filled in by the sender; the recipient cannot change it.

value.description:
Signature and initials: PNG as base64. Text and name: the text. Checkbox: `true` or
`false`. Date: an ISO date.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

auditHead.description: Hash of the last audit event.

valid.description: One trusted seal, cryptographically valid, covering every byte.

reason.description: Why the check failed; `null` when it passed.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sealed file as stored.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that sent the envelope, for its brand.

waitingFor.description: Signers and approvers who have not acted yet.

sealed.description: The signed copy is ready to download.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that sent the envelope, for its brand.

values.description: Values already entered in this recipient's fields.

otpRequired.description: The recipient signs with a one-time code.

authenticated.description: A valid session came with this request.

key.description: How fields refer to this document in the same request. Default its position, `"0"`.

NewRecipient.description:
`email` is required for viewers and for `email_link` and `email_otp`; `phone` for
`sms_otp`.

key.description: How fields refer to this recipient in the same request. Default its position, `"0"`.

id.description: On `PATCH`, the id of an existing recipient to keep.

order.description: Signing order in sequential routing. Default the position in the list, from 1.

NewField.description:
A box on a page for one recipient. Give its position either as `x`, `y`, `width` and
`height` or as `rect`.

document.description: The document's `key` or `id`. Optional when the envelope has one document.

message.description: Shown to recipients in the invitation and on the signing page.

expiresAt.description: When the envelope expires; must be in the future.

send.description: Send at once instead of keeping a draft.

envelope.description:
The same JSON as the JSON body, with `documents` holding only `{ key, name }` for
each file in upload order, or left out.

recipients.description: Replaces the recipients. Include `id` to keep an existing one.

id.description: The delivery id; the same on every retry.
